sources.title: Shohei Ohtani completes bullpen session; unclear if he'll pitch Sunday
sources.description: Shohei Ohtani threw about 20 pitches in the side session, which Dodgers manager Dave Roberts noted was "short," but he said he had no expectation for a pitch count.
